subject: Action required: benefits enrollment closes November 30
summary: Lumen Labs open enrollment closes November 30; without an election you get base medical plan only, no dental or vision.
reason: Enrollment has a real deadline with a consequence of losing dental and vision coverage if ignored.
action: Make benefit elections in the portal by Nov 30
body_text: Open enrollment closes November 30. If you don't make an election, you'll be enrolled in the base medical plan with no dental or vision. Make your choices in the benefits portal.
